faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about plans, billing, and renewals.

items.q: How is the daily interview quota calculated and refreshed?
items.a: Your daily interview quota is automatically refreshed at 00:00 every day. Each time you complete an AI session, 1 interview quota is deducted.

items.q: Can I upgrade from a lower tier to a higher tier anytime?
items.a: Yes, absolutely! The platform automatically calculates your unused plan balance (Upgrade Discount) so you only pay the prorated difference when upgrading.
We support instant, secure payments via PayOS with Napas247 QR code (scannable by any mobile banking app), domestic ATM cards, and international Visa/Mastercard.

items.q: What does Chatbot Context Window (Tokens) mean?
items.a: Larger token context allows the AI to retain full details of lengthy resumes and long conversation threads, delivering pinpoint accurate algorithmic breakdowns and customized feedback.

items.q: How quickly is my plan activated after payment?
items.a: Your account tier is activated in real time within seconds after the payment transfer is confirmed by our gateway.

items.q: Can I request a VAT invoice for corporate/business expenses?
items.a: Yes! If you represent an organization or require an official electronic VAT invoice, please reach out to contact@tpmson.com.
